address: # Constructors defined IN-CLASS in a header while carrying a // FUNCTION marker.
# a constructor is defined in-class IF AND ONLY IF the original has no standalone body
# for it. A ctor that owns an address stays out-of-line so that body pairs.
# Every in-class definition that still owns an address is therefore a deliberate
# exception and must be listed here with what it bought and what it cost. `outcome`
# is `traded` when the address went unpaired as a result, `free` when VC5 still emits
# the out-of-line copy and nothing was lost.
